video.title: <video> Video
video.quiz: Which tag is used to embed video?

source.title: <source> Media Source Tag
source.history: Specifies and defines multiple media resources for media elements like <video> and <audio> to support different formats.
source.code:
<video controls>
  <source src='movie.mp4' type='video/mp4'>
  <source src='movie.ogg' type='video/ogg'>
  Your browser does not support the video tag.
</video>
source.quiz: Which tag specifies multiple media resources for media elements?

track.title: <track> Text Track Tag
track.history: Used to specify text tracks, subtitles, captions, or descriptions for media elements like <video> and <audio>.
track.code:
<video controls>
  <source src='movie.mp4' type='video/mp4'>
  <track src='subtitles_en.vtt' kind='subtitles' srclang='en' label='English'>
  <track src='subtitles_fr.vtt' kind='subtitles' srclang='fr' label='French'>
</video>
track.quiz: Which tag is used to specify text tracks for media elements?

figure.title: <figure> Figure Tag
figure.history: Used to group media content with a caption.
figure.quiz: Which tag is used to group media content with a caption?

figcaption.title: <figcaption> Figcaption Tag
figcaption.history: Defines a caption for a <figure> element.
figcaption.quiz: Which tag defines a caption for a figure?

nav.title: <nav> Navigation Tag
